name: tayu-mvp
description: Tayu — a browser-based multiplayer financial-literacy game for K–5 students
author: Ayush Ranjan

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
